questions.prompt: Which description matches the star spirits after they landed?
choices: They bounced, giggled, and left gold trails.
They crawled silently and left muddy tracks.
They flew in circles and dropped blue feathers.
questions.answer: They bounced, giggled, and left gold trails.
questions.evidenceText:
The small things landed and bounced.
They bounced along the ground.
They made a sound like giggling.
They left gold trails where they bounced.

questions.prompt: Why must the star spirits be taken to Moonwood's highest point?
questions.evidenceText:
"They need height," said Luna.
"The highest point in Moonwood."

questions.prompt: What lesson is shown when Stone, Pip, and Spark lift the spirits together?
choices: Friends can help the spirits by working together.
Stone should send every spirit back alone.
The spirits do not need anyone's help.
questions.answer: Friends can help the spirits by working together.
questions.rationale: Stone raises the star spirits while Pip and Spark add a push, and the spirits then reach their places in the sky; this shows friends can help the spirits by working together.
questions.evidenceText:
Stone raised their hands high.
Pip and Spark added a little push.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
The star spirits went up.
Slowly at first.
Then faster.
One by one they found their places.
